units.source_text: “不，不，像我们字号，净是扩张，又是和服料子批发商，又是什么，简直是杂货铺！

en.t: “No, no, a shop like ours is always expanding, becoming a kimono-fabric wholesaler and who knows what else. It is practically a general store!
I am not very interested in that.

units.source_text: 要是少了像植村先生这样殷实可靠的人，店铺可就……”

en.t: If we were to lose a solid and dependable person like Mr. Uemura, the shop would be... ”
